_comment: Copy to ~/.config/ii-ai-bridge/backends.json and edit. Every entry becomes a model id the sidebar can select. kind is one of claude, ssh_claude, codex, agy.

second-account-sonnet._comment: A second Claude Code login lives in its own CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.

remote-sonnet._comment: Runs claude over ssh on another machine. The ssh host must work with BatchMode=yes.

agy-gemini-flash._comment: Antigravity CLI. Run 'agy models' for the id list.
